              title: Salutation

                from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, or UNKNOWN
                when the postcode is absent or in no known range) and HASH8 is the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name. Assigned at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode. Derived from the owner's own
                fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who belong to the same
                household (same last name and postcode). Deterministic: the first 12
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name,
                a '|' separator and the postcode, so every owner with the same last
                name and postcode computes the same value automatically. Null when
                the owner has no postcode (and so belongs to no household).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same first name and last name
                (case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'

                gains 2 when an email address is present, 1 when the owner has no
                namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), 2 when it belongs to a household of
                3 or more members, and 3 for tenure of more than 365 days. Derived
                from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is used to derive the owner's salutation.
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility (the flat form); when structured address fields are
            supplied it is derived instead. On output it is the composed, normalized
            address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address (e.g. street number and
            name). When supplied (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address'
            input and is normalized the same way (trim, collapse whitespace, upper-case,
            expand common street-type abbreviations).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            suite). When supplied it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
            The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid email address; the stored value is lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Serialized as an ISO date
            'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner. When present it is used
            to derive the owner's ageBand, computed against the registrationDate.
            Serialized as an ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the city's region: NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. When supplied it is stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and postcode (they share a household): it bypasses

All tests pass and the build succeeds. Here's a summary of what I implemented for the soft-delete change:

## Changes

**1. `Owner` entity** (`model/Owner.java`) — added a `deleted` field (`@Column(name = "deleted", nullable = false)`) defaulting to `false`, with getter/setter. A newly created owner is therefore `false` by default.

**2. `DeleteOwner` function** (`rest/function/owner/DeleteOwner.java`) — changed from a hard `repository.delete(owner)` to a soft-delete: sets `deleted = true` and `save`s the owner, retaining the row. The existing `DELETE.yml` pipeline (Load → Delete → RespondWithNoContent, 204) is unchanged and still returns 2xx.

**3. Create-path checks** — both now skip soft-deleted owners:
- `EnsureUniqueHousehold.java` — the blocking duplicate check ignores deleted owners, so a normally-blocking household duplicate is allowed when the only match is deleted.
- `FlagPossibleDuplicate.java` — the identity/possible-duplicate flag ignores deleted owners.

**4. API schema** (`openapi.yml`) — added a read-only `deleted` boolean to the `Owner` response schema so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it and MapStruct maps it; `GET` now reports `deleted`. It's on the response schema only (not `OwnerFields`), so the create request body doesn't accept it.

**5. DB schemas** — added `deleted BOOLEAN ... DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL` to all four dialects (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres). HSQLDB requires `DEFAULT` before `NOT NULL`, which was the one syntax wrinkle I hit and fixed.

Verification: `coreSoftDeleteFlagsAndRetains` and `coreDeletedOwnerIgnoredByDuplicateCheck` both pass, and the full `mvnw test` run reports **BUILD SUCCESS** (2 tests, 0 failures/errors).
